name: trace_native_values
description: Trace a bounded static dependency graph from one explicit native procedure. Includes high-p-code def-use, constants, operators, memory and branch operations, resolved call edges, and derived argument/parameter and return/output bindings. Missing bindings, alias semantics, persistent state and RNG roles remain unknown. Budgets bound depth, decompilations, graph size and payloads; nodes are paginated. A Ghidra per-function timeout does not bound the whole traversal; allow startup, every attempted function and other work, or reduce max_functions.
